up: Return exact IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against human prostaglandin E synthase (CHEMBL5658). For each matching activity row, provide the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and a PubMed ID or DOI. Only include activities where the standard relation is '='.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5658'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
